segments.name: Title Insurance
segments.description: Underwrites residential and commercial title insurance for owners and mortgagees of real estate through ITIC and NITIC.
segments.evidence: The Company's primary business activity, and one of its reportable operating segments, is the issuance of residential and commercial title insurance through ITIC and NITIC.

segments.name: Exchange Services
segments.description: Provides tax-deferred like-kind real property exchange services as a qualified intermediary through ITEC and ITAC.
segments.evidence: The Company's second reportable operating segment is providing tax-deferred real property exchange services through its subsidiaries, Investors Title Exchange Corporation ("ITEC") and Investors Title Accommodation Corporation ("ITAC").

segments.name: All Other
products: management services to title insurance agencies
segments.description: Comprises management services to title insurance agencies via ITMS and investment management and trust services via Investors Trust.
segments.evidence: None of these other lines of business is currently a reportable segment for which separate financial information is presented; instead, they are collectively included and reported in the category "All Other" in the segment information in Note 12 of the Notes to the Consolidated Financial Statements.

revenueModel.text: The Company earns one-time title insurance premiums from property owners and mortgagees at closing, exchange fees and interest on client deposits, and fees for management, investment and trust services.
revenueModel.evidence: Title insurance premiums written reflect a one-time premium payment, with no recurring premiums.
